unlisted_practices: Deliberative dialogue groups with screening-age women to elicit preferences on AI workflow options in breast screening
Retaining human control and preferring human-AI combined workflows over AI working alone for screening reads
Allowing time for consumers to become familiar with AI before implementation and justifying the need for AI deployment

screen.reason: Qualitative empirical study (deliberative dialogue groups) exploring consumer/patient preferences and reasoning regarding different AI workflow options and governance requirements for breast screening.
